sentence: This project uses deep learning to map how DNA folds in the nucleus from single cell samples.
This project brings together scientists and regulators to discuss using genetic engineering to manage pests such as mosquitoes and flies.
This project tries to find out which gene regulatory networks in different cell types drive the maturation of heart cells.
This project builds a light-activated tool that releases neuropeptides in vivo to study withdrawal from methamphetamine and other substances of abuse.
This project builds a deep convolutional neural network that sorts brain magnetic resonance images from people with Lewy Body diseases and Alzheimers disease.
This project studies how poor communication between fibroblast and epithelial cells in the uterus keeps the endometrial lining from getting ready for pregnancy.
This project studies how tobacco-specific nitrosamines and other tobacco carcinogens damage genes in the oral mucosa of people who use tobacco products.
This project combines machine learning with large datasets of matched T cell receptors and tumor antigens to predict and design how they recognize each other.
This project studies which circuits in the entorhinal cortex cause cognitive impairment after chemotherapy in a mouse model.
This project tries to find out how molecular mechanisms keep the light-sensitive outer segments of rod and cone photoreceptor cells healthy.
This project offers CRISPR gene editing and mouse models to help cancer researchers study gene and protein function.
This project tests how maternally inherited factors control early mammalian embryo development and prevent mosaicism.
This project offers imaging support and tumor measurements for cancer clinical trials that use computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging and positron emission tomography.
This project builds computational methods that use whole genome sequencing to trace the evolutionary history of cancer metastases in small-cell lung cancer.
This project tries to change the silk fiber of the Indianmeal moth with genetic engineering so silk proteins can be used in biomedical applications.
This project studies whether circulating senescence-associated proteins can help identify cancer survivors at high risk of age-related diseases and early death.
This project studies how neurons release neurotransmitters and how presynaptic plasticity works.
This project sets up a mass spectrometer system for proteomics and metabolomics research on health-related questions.
This project studies whether upper respiratory genetics and the nasal microbiome raise the risk of rheumatoid arthritis.
This project builds a CRISPR-based test that detects bacterial RNA quickly to guide antibiotic use in patients with sepsis.
